about.title: About Us
about.historyText:
JAGUAR LLAQTA begins operations in 2026 in Cusco, Peru, as an alternative tourism agency born from a conscious and respectful perspective, deeply linked to nature and the living ancestral culture of the country. We design authentic experiences that connect territory, community and traveler.

The agency arises from the meeting of two Peruvian friends who share the same vision and complementary backgrounds. One of them is an alternative tourism guide, with extensive experience in half-day, full-day and multi-day hikes, as well as direct work with local communities and experiential ancestral knowledge. The other brings experience in tourism administration and consulting, integrating a strategic, organizational and responsible management vision.
about.visionText: We hold the vision of becoming an alternative tourism agency recognized for its ethics, authenticity and commitment, generating a positive impact on the communities it works with and contributing to the environmental and cultural awareness of travelers, industry companies and local stakeholders.
about.missionText: Our mission is to offer nature tourism experiences, hikes and cultural experiences developed with deep respect for the environment and local communities, promoting the revaluation of Peru's ancestral culture through alternative routes to conventional tourism.
about.objectiveThree: Promote knowledge and respect for Andean communities
about.objectiveFour: Inform and educate about ancestral traditions and living culture
about.authenticityDesc: We offer routes and experiences outside conventional tourism
about.respectDesc: Years of direct work with communities and alternative routes
about.commitmentDesc: We integrate nature, community and ceremonies in every experience
about.teamText: Our team of local guides and collaborators, committed to offering authentic experiences.
about.organizationsText: We work hand in hand with local communities, spiritual masters and organizations committed to sustainable tourism.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: No. We have different routes with varying levels of difficulty. During the Pre-Booking we will ask you to honestly answer some screening questions to confirm if the chosen route is right for you.
faq.q2: Can I do a tour alone?
faq.a2: Yes. Although tours indicate the minimum recommended number of people for the suggested price, you have the option to request a private tour. Keep in mind that this would result in increased service costs.
faq.q3: What should I bring to the tour?
faq.a3: All our routes and experiences are detailed on the website, specifying what items are recommended for each specific tour.
faq.q4: How do I make my payment?
faq.a4: We currently have payment options via cash, bank transfer, and digital wallets (Yape, Plin). For any other payment method, please contact us by email or phone. Please note that any bank charges or additional fees will be assumed by the client or person making the deposit.
